skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this script into a 30-second video with visuals and background music...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video High Quality — Generate HD Videos from Text.

- Instantly turn written descriptions or scripts into professional 1080p videos with background music.
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT uploads (up to 500MB), with fully automated AI video creation.
- User-friendly setup: automatic backend connection and free token generation (guaranteed 7-day access, 100 free credits).
- Flexible workflows for quick edits, batch processing, or iterative refinement.
- Reliable export options and detailed error handling for a smooth experience.
- Ideal for marketers, content creators, and educators wanting high-quality videos without editing skills.
